name: Workspace Styles
author: jgarza
description: Workspace indicator with an active-workspace decoration (pill, rounded square, underline, bold, glow), a switch animation (none, pop, hypr-pop, glitch, neon), a glyph set (numbers, roman numerals, kanji, dice, dots, Nerd Font icons), and an indicator color role (accent, selection, muted) all chosen independently, so you can mix and match.

barWidget.description: Workspace 1..N switcher with an independently pickable indicator shape, animation, color, and glyph set.

schema.label: Workspace count
schema.description: How many workspace slots to show, left to right. A live workspace beyond this count still appears if it's occupied or focused.

schema.label: Indicator
schema.description: How the active workspace is highlighted.

options.label: Pill
options.description: Rounded accent capsule fills the active cell.

options.label: Rounded Square
options.description: Like Pill, but with squared-off corners instead of a full capsule.

options.label: Underline
options.description: Minimal accent bar under the active cell.

options.label: Bold
options.description: No shape - the active glyph just goes bold and bright.

options.label: Glow
options.description: A soft glow fills the active cell behind the glyph - no shape, no border.

schema.label: Animation
schema.description: Motion played on the active glyph every time focus switches to it. Independent of Indicator - combine any animation with any indicator.

options.label: None
options.description: No animation on switch - the indicator just appears.

options.label: Pop
options.description: The active glyph scales up briefly on every switch.

options.label: Hypr-pop
options.description: A much bigger, springier multi-stage bounce + rotation wobble, plus its own expanding shockwave ring - deliberately over the top.

options.label: Glitch
options.description: A bigger digital-glitch burst - rapid position jitter with a color-tint flash and a cyan/magenta chromatic-aberration fringe.

options.label: Neon
options.description: The glyph flickers through brightness variations of your theme's accent color, with a lick-of-flame scale wobble.

schema.label: Glyphs
schema.description: What's drawn inside each workspace cell.

options.label: Japanese
options.description: Japanese numerals, 一 through 十.

options.label: Dots
options.description: No numerals - a plain position dot per workspace.

options.label: Custom icons
options.description: Your own Nerd Font glyph or emoji per workspace.

schema.label: Indicator color
schema.description: Which theme color role paints the active indicator.

schema.label: Custom icon glyphs
schema.description: Comma-separated glyph or emoji per workspace slot, left to right. Only used by the Custom icons glyph set; empty slots fall back to the workspace number.
